tools.name: list_services
tools.title: List services
tools.description: List the digital design and marketing services offered by Royal Digital Elevation (Nairobi, Kenya), with summaries and site paths.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.title: Get pricing
tools.description: Get Royal Digital Elevation pricing in KES: individual service rates, bundle packages, monthly plans, bulk-bundle discounts and payment terms. Optionally filter to one service category.

category.description: Optional service category to filter by, e.g. "Graphic Design", "Video Editing", "Social Media Marketing", "Copywriting", "Email Marketing", "SMS Marketing". Omit for everything.

tools.name: list_blog_posts
tools.title: List blog posts
tools.description: List blog posts from Royal Digital Elevation (SEO, Design, Social Media and Marketing topics) with title, excerpt, category, date and featured image. Optionally filter by category.

category.description: Optional category filter, e.g. "SEO", "Design", "Social Media", "Marketing". Omit for all posts.

tools.name: get_blog_post
tools.title: Get blog post
tools.description: Get the full content of a single Royal Digital Elevation blog post by its slug (from list_blog_posts). Returns title, metadata, featured image and full HTML content.

tools.name: get_business_info
tools.title: Get business info
tools.description: Get Royal Digital Elevation's public business details: contact email, phone, WhatsApp, location, social media links, and payment terms.
